items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: When they were doing that we had Joe Loicano on saxophone and his brother singing.

ctx.x: Uh, Barrettaria. Uh. Some Sweetheart tune. Nobody, nobody's a sweetheart. Uh uh. Let me call you Sweetheart. Barrettaria. Uh. One of Red Long's tunes. Uh. When I was loving you, you were loving someone else. Oh yeah. Uh. When they were doing that we had Joe Loicano on saxophone and his brother singing. Either his brother or Johnny Sabre singing. And uh. Well I made a bunch of them at the halfway house.
Now Barrettaria, you remember who the guys in the band? Rap was on that.
